projects.title: Document Data Mining Project in Java
projects.description:
Aim to capture information from Reuters database to classify unknown articles. 
Build classifiers based on document information by implementing different algorithms (K-nearest neighbors, decision trees, association rules). Decrease online and offline time cost by selecting classification methods.

projects.title: Online Bookstore Database Design and Documentation
projects.description:
Designed entity relationship model and relational schema. Created the database in SQLite, imported test data from Excel file and tested operations from the aspect of bookstore users and administrators.
Wrote a user manual with samples.
